info.title: PAM Accounting API
info.description: API for managing PAM SOA (accounting reviews), accounting reminders, and accounting data records

tags.name: accounting-reviews
tags.description: Operations related to PAM SOA accounting reviews

tags.name: accounting-records
tags.description: Operations related to accounting data records loading and filtering

get.description: Retrieve PAM SOA list with pagination, filtering, sorting, and field selection.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in response. Allowed: soa_id,sap_id,sap_period_type,sap_year,loc_id,rp_id,soa_status,soa_confirmdate,soa_confirmedfrom,soa_comment,soa_action,sap_period

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by. Use '-' for descending. Allowed: soa_id,sap_id,sap_period_type,sap_year,loc_id,rp_id,soa_status,soa_confirmdate,soa_confirmedfrom,soa_comment,soa_action,sap_period

post.description: Create a new PAM SOA entry. The server will set soa_confirmdate to now.

get.summary: Get a PAM SOA by id

post.summary: Mark a PAM SOA as partially incorrect
post.description: Marks a PAM SOA record as partially incorrect (sets status to 2). Only records with status different than 1 can be marked as partially incorrect. The soa_confirmedfrom field is automatically set from the authenticated user's email.

200.description: PAM SOA marked as partially incorrect successfully

get.description: Retrieve reminders list with pagination, filtering, sorting, and field selection.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in response. Allowed: id,from,to,status,template_data,created_at,updated_at

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by. Use '-' for descending. Allowed: id,from,to,status,template_data,created_at,updated_at

post.summary: Reset a PAM SOA to initial state
post.description: Resets a PAM SOA record to its initial state (status 0). Only records with status 1 or 2 can be reset. This action clears soa_comment, soa_action, soa_confirmdate, and soa_confirmedfrom fields.

Confirms a PAM SOA record (sets status to 1 and updates confirmedfrom field). The soa_confirmedfrom field is automatically set from the authenticated user's email. Pool owners cannot confirm records with status 2 (partially incorrect) unless they are admins or location admins.

get.description: Retrieve accounting data with pagination, filtering, and format options (hierarchical or JSON API). Supports multiple view types.

parameters.name: filter[periodStartDate]
parameters.description: Period start date filter (ISO date format)

parameters.name: filter[periodFinishDate]
parameters.description: Period end date filter (ISO date format)

parameters.name: filter[sapPeriodType]
parameters.description: SAP period type filter (0 = weekly, 1 = monthly). Defaults to 1 if not provided.

parameters.name: filter[locSapPeriod]
parameters.description: Location SAP period filter (0 or 1). Defaults to 1 if not provided.

parameters.name: filter[locationID]
parameters.description: Location ID filter (single integer or comma-separated values)

parameters.name: filter[resourcePoolID]
parameters.description: Resource pool ID filter (single integer or comma-separated values)

get.summary: Get filter options for accounting data
get.description: Retrieve available filter options based on user authentication including locations, resource pools, cost centers, and SAP periods.

parameters.name: sapYear
parameters.description: SAP year to filter available options

parameters.name: sapPeriod
parameters.description: SAP period to filter available options

parameters.name: locationID
parameters.description: Location ID filter (single integer or comma-separated values)

parameters.name: resourcePoolID
parameters.description: Resource pool ID filter (single integer or comma-separated values)

get.description: Retrieve pool owners list with pagination and optional pool inclusion, filtered by SAP parameters and optional location.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Allowed: pools

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of location names to filter by (e.g., 'Shenzhen,Tunis')

included.description: Included pools when include=pools is specified

ressource.description: Resource or pool display name (for workstep-resources view)

resourcePool.description: Resource pool display name (for pools/resources views)

project.description: Project name (for project rows in workstep-projects view)

type.description: Resource type: '1' for external, '0' for internal (only present for resource rows)

plannedEffortsPercentage.description: Percentage of planned efforts relative to working time

workingTimeGlaz.description: Working time with GLAZ breakdown (format: RegWork - GLAZ = RegWork_Glaz)

accountedEffortsDifference.description: Difference between accounted efforts and working time minus GLAZ

hasLink.description: Whether the row has a link to SOA details (true for status 2)

soaConfirmedFrom.description: Email of user who confirmed the SOA

tags.description: Array of tag objects for date range display

subRows.description: Nested child rows for hierarchical structure

locations.description: Available locations based on user access and filters

resourcePools.description: Available resource pools based on user access and filters

sapPeriods.description: Available SAP periods (last 10 months) based on user access and filters

costCenters.description: Available cost centers based on user access and filters

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - Validation errors or invalid parameters

bearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme
